title: A Volcano Turned a Man's Brain Into Glass in 79 AD

scenes.text: A volcano turned a man's brain into glass.
In the year 79, Vesuvius buried the Roman town of Herculaneum.
A cloud of burning ash hit the town at around 500 degrees Celsius.
One young man's brain was found inside his skull as shiny, black glass.
The ash cooled very fast, so the tissue turned to glass instead of burning away.
Scientists could still see his neurons, almost two thousand years later.

description:
A volcano turned a man's brain into glass.
When Vesuvius erupted in the year 79, scorching ash hit the town of Herculaneum. In one victim, the heat and fast cooling turned brain tissue into black glass that still shows neuron shapes under a microscope.
